trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Omar: Only trainers who've beaten every Gym get this far. Let's see what your eight Badges are worth!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Omar: Worth a great deal, clearly.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Ace Trainer Sydney: The Elite Four are waiting just past this cave, and I mean to reach them first!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Ace Trainer Sydney: You go on ahead. I'll catch you up.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Veteran Clayton: You youngsters race through Victory Road. Slow down and battle an old hand!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Veteran Clayton: You're in a hurry for good reason, I see.

trainer.dialogueBefore: Al: Kay and I have climbed all of Victory Road side by side. We battle side by side too!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Al: Back down to the bottom and up again, Kay?

trainer.dialogueBefore: Kay: Two against two! Let's see how good your teamwork is!
trainer.dialogueAfter: Kay: Our teamwork needs some work, Al.
